home.cardQ: How would you design a high-concurrency rate limiter?
home.cardA: Use a Redis counter, +1 per request, reject above the threshold…
home.cardNote: You mentioned a counter, but talk through sliding vs. fixed window trade-offs and atomicity in a distributed setting — covering those makes it solid.
